bash -lc 'cat > /workspace/generate_screenshot.py <<"PY"
import sys
width=900
height=420
try:
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
except Exception as e:
    Image=None

if Image is None:
    # Fallback: write a simple PPM image which most viewers can open
    with open("assets/screenshot-settings-cassette.ppm","w") as f:
        f.write("P3
")
        f.write(f"{width} {height}
")
        f.write("255
")
        for y in range(height):
            row=[]
            for x in range(width):
                r=int(60 + (x/width)*120)
                g=int(110 + (y/height)*60)
                b=int(180 - (x/width)*40)
                row.append(f"{r} {g} {b}")
            f.write(" ".join(row) + "
")
    print("Wrote assets/screenshot-settings-cassette.ppm")
    sys.exit(0)

# PIL path exists - draw nicer image
im=None
try:
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
    im=Image.new("RGB",(width,height),(245,245,245))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    fnt=None
    try:
        fnt=ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",22)
    except Exception:
        pass
    d.rectangle([20,60,880,360], fill=(240,240,240))
    d.rectangle([40,70,300,110], fill=(200,200,255))
    d.rectangle([320,70,520,110], fill=(200,255,200))
    d.rectangle([540,70,860,110], fill=(255,230,180))
    d.text((60,40),"Settings", fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
    d.text((60,90),"Screen: Cassette", fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
    d.text((60,120),"Variant: v2 (cassette)", fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
    d.text((60,150),"Cassette controls appear below screen", fill=(0,0,0), font=fnt)
    im.save("assets/screenshot-settings-cassette.png")
    print("Wrote assets/screenshot-settings-cassette.png")
except Exception as e:
    print("Error generating image:",e)
    sys.exit(1)
